d: Nisha bhagat mamle men rashtriy mahila aayog ki adhyaksh vijya rahatkar pahunchin unke aavas, pita se mulakat kar vyakt ki sanvedna, kaha- doshiyon ke khilaph hogi karravaee aur nisha ko nyay dilane ke lie aayog karega harsanbhav prayasa. vahin, esaaaeeaar ko lekar 18 navanbar ko rajy ke sabhi matdan kendron par lagega ek aur avsar kainp, mukhy nirvachan padadhikari ne kaha- patr matdataon ko matdata suchi men nam jurvane ka milega ek aur mauka. idhar, chhath mahaparv ko lekar jharkhand men taiyariyan tej, relve ki or se yatriyon ki suvidha ke lie kie ja rahe vishesh intjam, chhath ghaton…
